title: Alder Signal
pitch: A short atmospheric first-person field mission: restore three forest survey relays and return to the trailhead before the radio window closes.

authorization.basis: User authorized autonomous additive _tech9 foundation work and one complete small proof game, including creative judgment, bounded subagents, local commits and browser testing; resumed explicitly on 2026-09-24. Preserve the existing root framework; defer root replacement and the next substantial game. User further clarified: root migration is WAY later, after this scene POC and further game experiments; stop at Alder Signal ready for user playtest and iterate with the user.

mustHave: Grounded first-person movement and approximate solid-tree/rock collisions
Three visible authored relays with hold-to-interact feedback
Readable navigation, countdown and mission state
Start, pause/resume, win, loss and restart
Local audio with mute, activated by user input
Real keyboard browser playthrough and compact independent review
outOfScope: Procedural streaming, networking or live scene switching
Replacing, retiring or rewiring the existing root framework

milestones.title: Owned starter and execution contract
acceptance: Independent _tech9 and scene checks pass; root framework restored
Fresh fork builds without framework imports

milestones.title: One complete field mission
acceptance: Pause and restart preserve/reset expected state

milestones.title: Verified playtest handoff
acceptance: Unit, lint, build and browser checks pass
Initial independent game/art critique recorded honestly; further art rounds deferred until user playtest feedback
Performance measured on named hardware at fixed settings
All deliverable and critique checkpoints committed

lanes.role: Plan, integration, documentation and final ownership
Implement and wire the complete playable loop
Read-only independent gameplay and visual review on committed source

playthrough: Start through visible UI; navigate with real keyboard input to all three relays, hold interaction and return to base
Pause while moving; verify timer and camera stop, then resume
Reach timeout loss and restart into clean mission state
Inspect start, gameplay and completion at desktop and narrow viewport; narrow screen may show desktop input guidance

stopAfter: Stop implementation once Alder Signal is ready for user playtest; hand over the local playable build and iterate from user feedback. Root graduation is WAY later, after additional game/agent POCs, and is not part of this goal.
